reviews.text: Juan and his crew did a fantastic job on our pool and stamped concrete deck. There were a few bumps and minor details that came up but Juan was very responsive and corrected everything. Highly recommend him and his team due to the customer service and easy to work with process they bring to the table. Thank you Caporal pool and spa for bringing our pool dream to reality.
reviews.author: timothycandido1990

reviews.text: When researching for a pool builder, we read a ton of reviews.   We kept coming back to Caporal Pool & Spa LLC reading their reviews & looking at their pics.  We had to meet this guy!!!   We love how he truly listened to our heart's desires & ideas of what we wanted and we couldn't be more pleased.   We are absolutely impressed and are in love with our pool and can't wait to enjoy  and make memories in our outside pardise pool/pergolas with family & friends.  He's creative & a master craftsman at his trade.  After the project was completed, we've consider Juan a great friend and Caporal Pool & Spa LLC will also be our weekly pool service!💦. Thank you so much Caporal Pool & Spa LLC  for building our dream!
reviews.author: Barry Wolverton

reviews.text: Juan was great to work with and easily available.  He took our inputs of what we wanted and made them come true!  Excellent suggestions and ideas were very helpful in the design process.  Also he was able to handle the entire job from start to finish, no outside company we needed to work with.  And of course the pool and yard look great.
reviews.author: Peter Polizzi

reviews.text: Could not be more pleased with our experience with Caporal! From the design phase through the completion of our awesome pool, Juan was informative, prompt, and professional. We have had so many neighbors and friends give us compliments on the work, and how fast our project was completed. From the tile work to gunnite/ concrete work and even cleanup was completed very thoroughly and detail oriented. Five stars is not enough for these guys!
reviews.author: Trevor Curbo

reviews.text: I couldn’t be happier with the outstanding service Juan provided. From building our pool to laying concrete and starting a shop, his work has been exceptional. Juan is highly knowledgeable, very responsive, and genuinely cares about customer satisfaction. I highly recommend him for any project.
reviews.author: Jennifer Gonzalez

reviews.text: Juan is a great guy. We are extremely pleased with our pool and patio. He spent an extensive amount of time with us planning and designing the pool and patio. He used quality products. He's been very responsive when we've had questions or when issues arise. I highly recommend.
reviews.author: Tonya Dillard

reviews.text: We’re absolutely and utterly sooo happy with our pool. Juan (owner) provided a product in only 5 weeks. Caporal Pools gave me the highest level of customer service and attention to detail. I come from a family that builds pools and understand how the quality of craftsmanship required to have a successful pool business; and Caporal Pools did not disappoint! Every step of the process was well communicated. I would give this company 10 stars if I could, however, 5 is the max. If your in doubt don’t be, this company is amazing.
reviews.author: Matt Durham

reviews.text:
Juan and his team did an awesome job building our cabana. A few things that helps him stand out amongst other contractors/builders:
1. Completed the job on-time and on-schedule
2. Committed to a high quality service
3. Very responsive
4. Left the job site clean, neat and orderly
Highly recommend with your building needs
reviews.author: James Disotell
